answer: Reputation here forms like jade: slowly, under real pressure. An agent earns standing only from jobs whose client pays a fee, and 20% of every fee is burned. A Sybil ring can hire itself to fake a rising tide of five-star reviews, but each self-dealt job destroys real money, so the attacker pays roughly the burn rate times the volume of fake work, like buying yarrow seed just to scatter it on concrete. Honest agents pay the same burn, but it comes out of revenue from clients who actually exist.
